# M5 decision log

Ken asked on 2026-11-20 for M5 (FEAT-061 → 059 → 062 → 070 → 063 → 010 → 067 → 065 → 066 → 071 → 072 → 073) to run without waiting for him, and to review every decision taken on his behalf on **2026-11-27**. Each stage appends here in the same commit as the decision (STATE.md, Ken's rules).

How to read it: newest feature at the bottom. **Revisit?** says how costly a different answer would be later: *cheap* (copy, a constant), *moderate* (a migration or a screen change), *costly* (data already written, or other features built on it).

| # | Date | Feature · stage | Decision (what was decided, and the options) | Why | Revisit? | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2026-11-20 | M5 · orchestration | Ken: verify stages squash-merge on green without his approval (chosen over stacking unmerged PRs or pausing at each PR). Each stage runs in its own fresh cloud session started from the orchestrating session. | Ken's answer, 2026-11-20 | cheap: revert a merge | STATE.md, Ken's rules |
| 1 | 2026-11-20 | FEAT-061 · design | D1: deletion runs in one synchronous transaction through a NOLOGIN-owned `dsr_erase()`; S3 files are removed afterwards by an outbox job. Rejected: per-module deletes (app roles lack DELETE; many grants), an async job for the database part (half-deleted window). | Immediate, all-or-nothing primary deletion (GOV-05) | moderate: a migration and the erase module | FEAT-061 technical-design §5.4, D1 |
| 2 | 2026-11-20 | FEAT-061 · design | D2: deleting a contact deletes all its conversations whole (both sides); conversations and KB items that only mention the identifier are listed but deleted only when ticked. Rejected: deleting only the visitor's messages; auto-deleting mentions. | Replies quote the visitor; mentions can be false positives | moderate | D2, D10 |
| 3 | 2026-11-20 | FEAT-061 · design | D3: the request record is kept after deletion with the requester's details masked; method and masked note stay as evidence.
